values.note: $24 a night for a standard site, $21 for the walk-to site, in every 2025-2028 rate season. $7-8 per extra vehicle a night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/bay-view-campground ('Single Site: $24 per night', 'Single Site (Walk up): $21 per night', 'A fee of $7.00 per additional vehicle, per day, applies in all concessionaire campgrounds') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234613/rates (STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24, WALK TO 21, 2026-2028) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234613 ('Extra vehicle will be charged an $8 per night fee'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Golden Age and America the Beautiful Senior/Access passes give half-price camping; Military Annual and Gold Star passes cover day-use fees only, not camping.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/bay-view-campground ('Discount passes are honored with ½ price camping only include: Golden Age Passport and America the Beautiful (Interagency) Senior Pass ...', 'Military Annual and Gold Star Veteran Passes are good for covering day use fees ONLY, they do not cover camping fees'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/bay-view-campground ('Campground is rustic. There are no hookups for electricity, water or sewer'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The Forest Service says 25 sites; recreation.gov lists 24: 23 drive-in (16 reservable, 6 first-come, one held by management) and a walk-to site. RV lengths 20-50 ft: sites 01, 02, 07-10 and 14 are 20 ft, the rest 30-50; 13 is a pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/bay-view-campground ('Twenty-five campsites are available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:234613 (23 STANDARD NONELECTRIC: 16 Open, 6 Not Reservable, 1 Not Reservable Management; 1 WALK TO; Max Vehicle Length 20-50; 13 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Vault toilets and hand-pumped drinking water at several points in the campground. No office on site: self-pay station.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234613 ('Vault toilets and hand-pumped drinking water are available at several locations within the campground'; 'We do not have an office at this location. It has a self pay station') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/bay-view-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Run by a concessionaire ((906) 767-1111). 16 sites reservable on recreation.gov (or 1-877-444-6777) up to 4 days before arrival; the rest first-come, and the first week of the season is first-come. Occupy a reserved site the first night; it is forfeited if you have not arrived by check-out time the next day. Up to 14 consecutive days.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/hiawatha/recreation/bay-view-campground ('Reservations can be made online at Recreation.gov or by calling 1-877-444-6777. Campground has first come, first served sites and reservable sites', 'Contact Name: Concessionaire', 'Reservations are forfeited if you have not arrived by check-out time the day after your scheduled arrival') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234613 (reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', maxConsecutiveStay 14 days, minWeekendStay 0, minHolidayWeekendStay 0) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234613/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 to 05-21), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic Hiawatha NF campground on Lake Superior's Whitefish Bay, off the Whitefish Bay Scenic Byway (Lakeshore Drive) about 8 miles west of Brimley. Heavily shaded sites beneath pine, oak, maple and birch, a few steps from a sandy beach. Camp host lives on site in season. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov + catalog: concession-run, $24 (walk-to $21; confirmed), no hookups (FS), vault toilets and hand-pump water, 25 sites per FS (24 on rec.gov, to 50 ft, one pull-through), 16 reservable and the rest first-come, 14-night limit, no minimum, season May 15 - September 27. Added max_rig_ft, pull-through, vault toilets, season, the stated Senior/Access half-price (military passes cover day use only, in the note). Hiawatha alerts list nothing for this campground or Lakeshore Drive. Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
